so.text: A line’s final budget can be far from what Town Meeting voted. Compare spending to the final budget and the line can look on target when the vote was not.

blocks.title: Budget changes after the vote

blocks.alt: Table of every school general fund line, one fiscal year at a time, as two sums: the school budget to what was left, with cost moved to other funds by journal entry apart from what it spent; and what the line cost from every fund. Sortable by category and by every column

basis.label: Our placing of other funds’ spending on the lines

columns.label: Voted
columns.means: What Town Meeting voted for this line.

columns.label: Transfers in or out
columns.means: Budget shifted to or from other lines during the year. Only the permission to spend moves; no bills do.

columns.label: Carried from last year
columns.means: Orders from last year that were still unpaid, carried in along with the money to pay them.

columns.label: Budget
columns.means: What this line was allowed to spend: voted, plus transfers, plus carried.

columns.label: Spent before re-charges
columns.means: What the school budget spent on this line, before any bills were re-charged. Bills still owed at year end count.

columns.label: Re-charged to other funds
columns.means: The school budget paid these bills first. Later another fund paid it back the same amount. So the school budget spent less, and Left goes up.

columns.label: Re-charged from other funds
columns.means: Another fund paid these bills first. Later the school budget paid it back. So the school budget spent more, and Left goes down.

columns.label: Left
columns.means: What this line had left at year end. Above zero, it added to the surplus; below zero, other lines covered it.

columns.label: Spent by the school budget
columns.means: What the school budget spent on this line, after the re-charges.

columns.label: Paid by other funds, re-charged later
columns.means: The same bills as Re-charged to other funds: the school budget paid first, and another fund paid it back. They still count here, because they are still part of what this line cost.

columns.label: Paid by other funds, from the start
columns.means: Another fund paid these bills itself; the school budget never did, so Left does not change. Which bills count toward this line is our match, by payee or by kind of work.

columns.label: Total spent, all funds
columns.means: Everything this line cost, whoever paid.

groups.label: What the line cost, every fund

text.an_click: Click a bar to see its rows on the Expenses tab.
text.an_note: Bars are what each payee or memo was paid this year, split by the fund that paid. Re-charges are left out: they move bills between funds and pay nobody.
text.an_week_note: Each bar is one week, Monday to Sunday, everything paid or still owed that week, by fund. A bar below the line is a week bills were re-charged off the school budget. The shaded span is the fiscal year; anything to its left was posted before it began.
text.between: the lines in between: show every line
text.chip_direct: Paid by other funds, from the start
text.cost_sum: What the line cost, every fund
text.ex_note: One row per invoice, payroll warrant or journal entry. A purchase order shows only what it still owed at year end; one fully paid shows as its invoices. Payroll rows are whole pay runs, with no names. A bill re-charged to another fund is listed twice: taken off the school budget, and under the fund that paid it.
text.failed: The rows could not be loaded.
text.footing: Spent counts orders still owed at year end, so for FY2025 and earlier Left can differ from the Town’s printed report by those orders.
text.mv_entries_def: Bills re-booked from one school line to another, or a correction. The budget does not move; which line carries the bill does.
text.mv_recharges: Re-charges to and from other funds
text.mv_recharges_def: Bills the school budget had already paid, re-booked to a grant or another fund (or back). The budget does not move; who paid the bill does.
text.mv_transfers_def: Permission to spend, moved between lines by a vote or an approved transfer. No bill moves; the budget does.
text.no_recharges: No bills re-charged to or from another fund.
text.none: No other fund paid toward this line.
text.other_funds: Other funds: grants, the circuit breaker, fees and revolving funds, and capital articles. Re-charges are the Town’s own entries; which spending counts as paid from the start toward a line is our match, by payee or by kind of work.
text.payers: Other funds that paid toward this line
text.read: Other funds can pay a line’s bills in two ways, and only one of them changes Left. The school budget can pay first and a journal entry RE-CHARGE the bills to a grant or another fund later: the school budget’s spending falls and Left rises, and the line cost the same. Or the other fund can pay FROM THE START: Left is untouched, and the line cost more than the school budget shows. Hover or tap a circled amount to see each entry.
text.scroll: More columns: scroll the table sideways
text.shared: Many lines gave and many got in this one entry, and the books do not say which line’s money went to which. The other side, all together:
text.unmatched: Other funds’ spending not matched to any line

so.text: A line can end under because its bills were re-charged to another fund after the school budget paid them. Sorted by category, lines that cancel each other out sit side by side.

blocks.title: Every line, budget and cost

blocks.alt: Table, one fiscal year: each school budget line other funds paid toward, with the fund, its kind, how the money was placed on the line, the amount, the line’s budget and the share of its cost; sortable and filterable by kind of fund

basis.label: Our placing of other funds’ spending on the lines

how.label: Re-charged from the school budget
how.means: The school budget paid the bills; a journal entry later put them on this fund. In the journal.

how.label: Re-charged back to the school budget
how.means: This fund paid first; a journal entry later put the bills on the school budget. Negative here.

how.label: Same payee as the line
how.means: The fund paid a payee this line also pays. Our match.

how.label: Same function code, category only
how.means: Spending with no payee to match -- payroll mostly -- under a function code of this category. Our match, and it cannot say which line.

text.budget_means: The line’s final budget: what was voted, plus or minus transfers, plus last year’s orders carried in. It ties to the Town’s period-13 report.
text.changed_means: Final budget less the vote: transfers and orders carried in. Flagged where it moved by half or more and by at least $5,000 -- thresholds of ours.
text.filter: Filter by line, category or fund
text.of_budget_means: What other funds paid toward the line, as a share of its final budget: voted, plus transfers, plus orders carried in. Over 100% means more came from other funds than the budget gave the line.
text.of_voted_means: What other funds paid toward the line, as a share of what Town Meeting voted for it. Far above the final-budget share means transfers topped the line up during the year.
text.open: Open a line for the funds that paid toward it
text.scroll: More columns: scroll the table sideways
text.share_means: What this fund paid, as a share of everything the line cost from every fund.

columns.label: Same payee as a school line

columns.label: On no school line

conclusions.claim: FY2023 left $32,022: $849,302 on lines under budget, less $817,280 spent past budget on the rest.
conclusions.so: The surplus is a net. 71 lines ran over and were covered by leftovers elsewhere in the same budget.

conclusions.claim: Journal entries re-charged $121,917 of bills off the school budget and $4,323 back onto it.
conclusions.so: Net, they raised Left by $117,595. The bills cost the same either way; only the fund that paid them changed.

conclusions.claim: Grants and other funds paid $1,705,717 toward these lines from the start.
conclusions.so: That money never passed through the school budget, so Left does not show it. Which line it counts toward is our match, by payee or kind of work.

conclusions.so: The budget carried in for them was not spent, so it ends the year as Left.
